name: form
useFor: Use Form with react-hook-form's useForm: FormField for each value, FormItem around its FormLabel, FormControl (around exactly one control), FormDescription and FormMessage. Stack items in a grid with gap-6. For forms without react-hook-form use Field.
constraints: Messages in any color but the orange
Wrapping more than one element in FormControl
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website's type and lines and the principles for fields (the site has no forms)
title: Form
description: react-hook-form helpers laid out as Field: a 14px medium label 8px above the control, 14px quiet help and a 14px orange message below; the control alone takes the orange edge when it fails.
